rars - https://github.com/bitplane/rars
Pinned source: e2415a2eb12e6b62deaa0cca919864eabe4671b1
Actual crate version at this commit: 0.12.3 (cached GitHub pages showed 0.11.0).
License: Apache-2.0; see LICENSE.txt.

Pathweft builds the Rust library from source through native/pathweft-rars.
Only the codec/rewrite library and its locked dependencies are used at runtime;
no upstream CLI, Python, TypeScript, WebAssembly, installer or updater is shipped.
The metadata-copy sequence in the Pathweft bridge is adapted from
crates/rars-python/src/lib.rs; its legacy Unicode field encoder is adapted from
crates/rars/src/filename.rs at the pinned commit. It omits link/redirection
support, requires UTF-8 entry identity, uses upstream preservation preflight and
keeps publication and independent decoding verification in Pathweft.
Changes are Pathweft's; the upstream project does not endorse this integration.

Rebuild: scripts/Build-RarsDependency.ps1 with registered native scratch.
Cargo.lock pins the transitive graph. S8 must include matching source, bridge,
lock, rebuild instructions and all applicable dependency notices in its release.
